data.name: Asyraf
data.long_meaning: One who is a lion among men

in_arabic.name: أشرف
in_arabic.meaning: الأشرف يعني الأعلى شرفا و هو من أسماء الله الحسنى
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أشرف هو من أسماء الله الحسنى و يعني الأعلى شرفا و الأكثر كرامة و هو مشتق من الشرف و العزة و يدل على الرفعة و المكانة الرفيعة في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: اشرف
in_urdu.meaning: اشرف کا مطلب ہے اعلیٰ شرف والا اور عزت والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اشرف نام اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اعلیٰ شرف والا اور عزت والا۔ یہ نام شرف اور عزت کی جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی تقالید میں بلند مقام اور عظمت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अशरफ
in_hindi.meaning: अशरफ का अर्थ है उच्चतम सम्मान और गरिमा वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: अशरफ नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है और इसका अर्थ है उच्चतम सम्मान और गरिमा वाला। यह नाम शرف और इज्जत की जड़ से निकला है और उच्च स्थान और महानता की प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: اشرف
in_pashto.meaning: اشرف د معنا دے لوړ شرف لرونکی او عزت لرونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: اشرف نوم د الله تعالیٰ د ښو نومونو څخه یو دی چې د معنا دے لوړ شرف لرونکی او عزت لرونکی. دا نوم د شرف او عزت د ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د لوړ مقام او بزرګي په ګوته کوي

in_english.name: Asyraf
in_english.meaning: Noble, Honorable, and Exalted in rank and dignity
in_english.long_meaning: The name Asyraf is derived from the Arabic root 'ش-ر-ف' which signifies nobility, honor, and exaltation. It is considered one of the attributes of Allah in Islamic tradition, implying someone who is of the highest rank and dignity. The name reflects qualities of nobility, respect, and high social standing, making it a revered and esteemed name in Muslim cultures

data.cultural_impact: The name "Asyraf" holds a great cultural significance especially among Islamic communities. It signifies strength, valor, and leadership. In many Muslim societies, lions were, and continue to be, a symbol of power and courage, representing the noble qualities of bravery and leadership. Asyraf embodies these attributes, reflecting a strong and fearless character.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic context, the name "Asyraf" also has profound spiritual significance. The lion represents different things in various religious traditions. In particular, in Islamic thought, the lion signifies purity and courageously standing up for the truth. Prophet Solomon was renowned for his connection to the lion, which symbolized the power and strength that God bestows upon His believers. Asyraf serves as a reminder of the spiritual strength that comes from imbibing God-consciousness and living an authentic Muslim life. The name is a constant inspiration to strive for excellent character and to live fearlessly for the truth.
